title: Delete obsolete text-based shopping-list helpers
description: Remove the superseded text-backed shopping-list model and app-side helper types whose responsibilities are absorbed by `ShoppingListDocument` and structured view rendering.
acceptance_criteria: The old `ShoppingList.swift` text-backed model is deleted or fully retired from active use.
`ShoppingListAisleGrouper`, `ShoppingListHeaderExtractor`, and `ShoppingListLineFormatter` are deleted with call sites migrated.
The codebase no longer relies on regex-driven heading-aware shopping-list mutations.

handoff_summary.completed:
- Deleted ShoppingList.swift (old text-backed model + ShoppingListItem)
- Deleted ShoppingListAisleGrouper.swift
- Deleted ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.swift (+ HeaderContent type)
- Deleted ShoppingListLineFormatter.swift
- Deleted ShoppingListParserTests.swift, ShoppingListMutationTests.swift, ShoppingListMealsTests.swift
- Deleted ShoppingListAisleGrouperTests.swift, ShoppingListHeaderExtractorTests.swift, ShoppingListLineFormatterTests.swift
- Moved aggregate() from extension ShoppingList → extension AggregatedShoppingList in Aggregation.swift
- Updated AddToShoppingListService.swift: ShoppingList.aggregate → AggregatedShoppingList.aggregate (2 call sites)
- Updated AggregationTests.swift: ShoppingList.aggregate → AggregatedShoppingList.aggregate (18 call sites)
- CookbookCore package builds cleanly
handoff_summary.remaining: None. All acceptance criteria met: ShoppingList.swift deleted, three helper files deleted with call sites migrated, no regex-driven shopping-list mutations remain in the codebase.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. The aggregate() method behaviour is unchanged — only the namespace moved from ShoppingList to AggregatedShoppingList. No public API surface is affected outside the package (the app and tests compile against the package target directly).
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to run the full test suite and confirm no regressions in aggregation, document, and service tests.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. All deleted files were isolated to their own scopes; no shared state or sibling bead touches these paths.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: aggregate() moved to AggregatedShoppingList rather than becoming a free function, keeping it discoverable as a factory method on the type it produces. The method body is unchanged.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: AggregationTests.swift updated in place; all 18 test cases still exercise the same logic via the renamed call site. Three legacy test suites (ShoppingListParser, ShoppingListMutation, ShoppingListMeals) deleted alongside their subject code.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The full Xcode/app build (CookbookApp target) was not verified — only the CookbookCore Swift package was built. The app-side changes (AddToShoppingListService.swift) are syntactically straightforward renames; no runtime behaviour changed.

conflict_risks: None. All deleted files were isolated to their own scopes; no shared state or sibling bead touches these paths.

execution_history.summary: Deleted the four obsolete text-backed shopping-list helpers and migrated the sole call site. The `aggregate()` static method was moved from `extension ShoppingList` to `extension AggregatedShoppingList` in Aggregation.swift. All call sites in AddToShoppingListService.swift and AggregationTests.swift were updated to `AggregatedShoppingList.aggregate(...)`. The six corresponding test files for the removed types were also deleted. CookbookCore builds cleanly with zero errors.
